data.long_meaning: Kandarp is a name derived from Sanskrit, meaning 'handsome' or 'beautiful'. In Hindu mythology, Kandarp is an ascetic, a celibate practitioner, and the charioteer of Lord Mahavishnu. This name embodies the traits of beauty, grace, and determination. The name Kandarp carries the meaning “Handsome, Beautiful” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Kandarp usually hope their child will grow to embody handsome, beautiful and live with faith, good character and purpose.
